item.title: THREE IN A ROW: Freshman helps Bravettes win region in final seconds
item.description: Trailing by three with a minute to go, the Baldwin Bravettes (17-10) went on an 8-0 run to clinch their third consecutive region championship by defeating the Cross Creek Lady Razorbacks 40-35 Friday.

item.title: Braves see their region reign end thanks to Cross Creek’s Tisby
item.description: The Baldwin Braves (23-4) knew they would have a fight on their hands in their quest to secure the program’s sixth straight region championship.

item.title: Local fundraiser helps to fight heart defects
item.description: Because of Brett, Owen Monroe received the first partial heart transplant at 17 days old and is thriving four years later.

item.title: RICH: Aunt Fairy
item.description: Every time we sing ‘Precious Memories’ at church or for a funeral, I always think of my daddy’s Aunt Fairy who raised him.

item.title: Community open house March 4 for new EV labs at CGTC campus
item.description: Central Georgia Technical College (CGTC) will open its doors to the community on Wednesday, March 4, with a drop-in open house from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., celebrating the completion of its new, state-of-the-art lab spaces for Electric Vehicle (EV) Automotive and Mechatronics on the Milledgeville campus.

item.title: House fire victims escape uninjured
item.description: Two men fled their home before daylight Monday after fire engulfed it on the 100 block of Garrett Way in Baldwin County, a local fire official says.

item.title: OUR SPACE: Pluto’s big heart
item.description: Every year right around this time since 2015 Pluto creeps its way back into the news. A favorite around Valentine’s Day because of its big surface feature resembling a heart, images of Pluto delight many space aficionados.

item.title: Flannery O’Connor Institute continues Southern Gothic Lecture Series with lecture by Kendra Hamilton, showing of ‘Sinners’
item.description: The Flannery O’Connor Institute for the Humanities, sponsored by Georgia Humanities, will hold the second annual lecture in the Southern Gothic Lecture Series this week.

item.title: GRIFFIN: Boots on the Ground at the Capitol
item.description: My colleagues and I returned to the Georgia State Capitol on Monday, Feb. 9, to kick off the fifth week of the 2026 legislative session.

item.title: GMC Prep’s Joyce Chow is Baldwin Co. STAR Student
item.description: Georgia Military College Prep Class of 2026 salutatorian Joyce Chow will represent Baldwin County at the regional STAR Student recognition next month.
